dimensionSummaries.crossArchitectureComparison: In Data Freshness, Agentic scores highest (9/10), while Fine-Tuned scores lowest (3/10). This dimension reflects the ability to access and incorporate recently updated information.
In Accuracy & Hallucination Control, Hybrid scores highest (8/10), while RAG scores lowest (6/10). This dimension reflects the ability to produce accurate outputs and minimize hallucinations.
In Latency, Fine-Tuned scores highest (9/10), while Agentic scores lowest (4/10). This dimension reflects response time and processing speed.
In Cost Efficiency, RAG scores highest (7/10), while Agentic scores lowest (3/10). This dimension reflects per-query operational costs.
In Governance & Auditability, Agentic scores highest (8/10), while Fine-Tuned scores lowest (3/10). This dimension reflects visibility into decision-making processes and audit trail quality.
In Workflow Complexity, RAG scores highest (8/10), while Agentic scores lowest (3/10). This dimension reflects implementation and operational complexity (higher scores indicate lower complexity).
In Team & Ops Readiness, RAG scores highest (7/10), while Agentic scores lowest (4/10). This dimension reflects the learning curve and operational expertise required.
